## The load-bearing one

**C-05.** This phase asserts the set is complete across four categories plus a
fifth that verification forced. That claim is the one most likely to be wrong,
because Phase 9 already found four vendors Phase 0 missed — one whole
category, in fact. The honest position is that the *white space* findings
(GAP-02, GAP-03) survived that discovery and got stronger, not weaker, but the
*set* should still be treated as good-not-exhaustive.

## What none of these needs

No new research. Every one is observable from vendor public pages, GeM award
records, or portal feature releases. That makes this phase the cheapest in the
programme to keep current — and the most likely to rot if nobody does.
